name: Kong
description: Kong describes itself as "The AI Connectivity Company," providing the connectivity layer for the agentic era — securely connecting, governing, and monetizing APIs and AI tokens across any model or cloud, via products like Kong Gateway and Kong Konnect.
best_for: Kong states it serves platform teams, developers, executives, and AI teams across financial services, healthcare, retail, and technology, including a startup program.
features: Kong AI Gateway for building/managing AI agents
API lifecycle management (design, publish, monetize) via Konnect
AI token consumption/cost governance and runtime entitlements
Developer Portal for API/MCP discovery and publishing
Security enforcement: access control, threat protection, resilience policies

alternatives.name: Apigee
alternatives.description: Google Cloud's API management platform offering design, security, analytics, and lifecycle management for enterprise APIs.
alternatives.best_for: Enterprises already on Google Cloud needing integrated API governance and analytics.

alternatives.name: RapidAPI
alternatives.description: An API hub/marketplace for discovering and consuming third-party APIs.
alternatives.best_for: Developers who want to find and test external APIs rather than manage internal gateway infrastructure.
